UpdateSourceArgs:
-c "set -e
ROOT=\"{{$FullRootDir}}\"
BASE=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}\"
URL='{{ServerUrl}}'
DVER='{{DotnetVersion}}'

dl() { if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL \"$1\" -o \"$2\"; else wget -qO \"$2\" \"$1\"; fi; }
unz() { if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -q -o \"$1\" -d \"$2\"; else python3 -m zipfile -e \"$1\" \"$2\"; fi; }

mkdir -p \"$ROOT\" \"$BASE\"

echo \"=== 1/4 runtime .NET $DVER ===\"
if [ ! -x \"$ROOT/dotnet/dotnet\" ]; then
  dl \"https://dotnetcli.azureedge.net/dotnet/Runtime/${DVER}/dotnet-runtime-${DVER}-linux-x64.tar.gz\" /tmp/dotnet.tar.gz
  mkdir -p \"$ROOT/dotnet\"
  tar -xzf /tmp/dotnet.tar.gz -C \"$ROOT/dotnet\"
  rm -f /tmp/dotnet.tar.gz
  echo \"runtime installe dans ${ROOT}dotnet\"
else
  echo \"runtime deja present : $(cat \"$ROOT/dotnet/dotnet\" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ok)\"
fi

echo \"=== 2/4 telechargement de l archive ===\"
echo \"source : $URL\"
dl \"$URL\" /tmp/rwmt.zip
ls -l /tmp/rwmt.zip
rm -rf /tmp/rwmt-x && mkdir -p /tmp/rwmt-x
unz /tmp/rwmt.zip /tmp/rwmt-x

SRC=/tmp/rwmt-x/Server/Linux
if [ ! -f \"$SRC/Server.dll\" ]; then
  echo \"ERREUR : Server/Linux/Server.dll absent de l archive, structure inattendue.\"; exit 1
fi

echo \"=== 3/4 garde-fou sur les donnees ===\"
for f in settings.toml save.zip Saved; do
  if [ -e \"$SRC/$f\" ]; then
    echo \"ERREUR : l archive contient $f, la copie ecraserait les donnees du serveur. Arret.\"; exit 1
  fi
done
echo \"aucune donnee dans l archive, copie sure\"

echo \"=== 4/4 copie des binaires et wrapper PTY ===\"
cp -a \"$SRC/.\" \"$BASE\"
chmod +x \"$BASE/Server\"
cat > \"$BASE/start.sh\" <<'EOS'
#!/bin/bash
cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\"
DN=\"${DOTNET_ROOT:-$(cd ../../dotnet 2>/dev/null && pwd)}/dotnet\"
[ -x \"$DN\" ] || DN=dotnet
if command -v script >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exec script -q -e -c \"$DN Server.dll\" /dev/null
fi
echo \"[wrapper] script absent : lancement direct, Console.KeyAvailable peut planter\" >&2
exec \"$DN\" Server.dll
EOS
chmod +x \"$BASE/start.sh\"
echo \"wrapper ecrit : ${BASE}start.sh\"
echo \"client pour les joueurs : {{ClientUrl}}\"
echo \"TERMINE : serveur RWMT a jour, settings.toml / save.zip / Saved preservee\"
"
